independent_reference.method: Independent Kronecker RY construction, independent C3X permutation, direct state evolution, outer-product density matrix and tensor partial traces.

limitations: Only the canonical four-qubit P2 instance is measured.
The results do not establish asymptotic scalability.
The results do not establish million-qubit or HPC performance.
The paired comparison is limited to the declared implementations.
Published results with different circuits or hardware are not equivalent records.
Benchmark results are supplementary evidence, not a substitute for mathematical validation.

literature_benchmarks.p2_comparability: Methodological reference only. Not an equivalent four-qubit operation-level timing record.
literature_benchmarks.scope: Benchpress suite with more than 1000 tests and circuits up to 930 qubits.
literature_benchmarks.title: Benchmarking the performance of quantum computing software for quantum circuit creation, manipulation and compilation

literature_benchmarks.p2_comparability: External simulator landscape. Hardware, circuits and measurement scope are not identical to P2.
literature_benchmarks.scope: Seven statevector simulators, circuits from 3 to 30 qubits, runtime, memory and multicore scalability.
literature_benchmarks.title: Benchmarking quantum computing statevector simulators on high-performance computing

runtime_measurement_scope: Elapsed wall-clock time from benchmark CLI start, before configuration loading, through the first complete generation of the four evidence files. Final JSON and Markdown persistence of the measured duration is excluded to avoid a self-referential timing measurement.
world_record_policy: A world-record value is populated only for an independently verified, directly comparable published measurement. No such measurement is currently established for the exact P2 operation-level workload.
